program The hub stops stalling
  goal
  > Every route under 100 ms while a meeting records.
  in app · main · project HoldSpeak
  template build and review
  control yolo
  check sh /Users/karol/dev/tools/wt-pg-imp6/tests/fixtures/fake_program_check.sh
  reviewer Codex at standard
  budget 64k
  night 23:30–07:00 · at most 8 steps
  within holdspeak/, docs/

every step
  R1 review: The change does only what its brief says.
  R2 review: Each new behaviour has a test.

at the end
  R5 word: I used the desk for a morning with no stall
    walk Open People at 393
    walk Start a meeting
    walk Open People again

round Architecture · asking
  ? Does the cache live in the hub or the client?
  = In the hub; the client stays as it is.

step 1 Indexes
  owns holdspeak/db/schema.py
  brief
  > Add the three indexes.

step 2 People routes
  owns holdspeak/web/routes/people.py
  brief
  > 31 handlers through run_in_threadpool.
  + Also the avatar route.
  R3 check: `echo 12 passed` is green
  R4 measure: The People routes answer fast
    run sh scripts/bench_people.sh
    bound p95 < 100 ms

step + The loop watch
  after 2
  agent Codex · effort low
  brief
  > Log each handler over 100 ms.

step 3 The fan-out
  after 1, 2
  budget 32k
  merge owner
  brief
  > One frame per change, not one per row.
